prompt.zh-TW: 青苔書店的老闆阿哲剛把一筆賣書的交易記進帳裡，想照五步驟檢查三張報表。步驟①他應該先看什麼？
prompt.en: Che, who runs Moss Bookshop, has just recorded a sale of books and wants to check the three statements with the five-step method. What should he look at first, in step 1?

text.zh-TW: 損益表上的五層利益有沒有照預期變動
text.en: Whether the five profit levels on the income statement moved as expected

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。步驟①只看五層利益，確認這筆交易對利益的影響合不合理；它沒有兩邊可以比對，所以不亮燈號。
feedback.en: Correct. Step 1 looks only at the five profit levels to see whether the effect on profit makes sense; there is no second side to compare, so it has no light.

text.zh-TW: 資產負債表的左邊和右邊加起來是不是一樣多
text.en: Whether the left and right sides of the balance sheet add up to the same amount

feedback.zh-TW: 左右相等確實要檢查，但那是最後一步（步驟⑤）。先從五層利益開始，才能看出交易有沒有記到正確的層。
feedback.en: Balancing does need checking, but it is the last step (step 5). Starting with the five profit levels shows whether the transaction landed on the right level.

text.zh-TW: 把損益表的稅前淨利與現金流量表的起點比對
text.en: Comparing profit before tax on the income statement with the start of the statement of cash flows

feedback.zh-TW: 這是步驟②要做的事，順序上還早了一步。步驟①只看五層利益、不做比對。
feedback.en: That is step 2, one step too early. Step 1 only looks at the five profit levels and compares nothing.

explanation.zh-TW: 五步驟的順序固定：{{option:o_2nwc}}是步驟①，接著才是步驟②到⑤的四個勾稽點。步驟①之所以沒有燈號，是因為五層利益只在損益表上出現，沒有另一張表可以對；它的用途是先確認這筆交易對利益的影響方向對不對。
explanation.en: The order of the five steps is fixed: {{option:o_2nwc}} is step 1, and only then come the four check points in steps 2 to 5. Step 1 has no light because the five profit levels appear only on the income statement, with no other statement to compare against; its job is to confirm that the transaction moved profit in the right direction.
